title.zh: 将北达沃省卡门市镇卡门—圣托马斯公路（伊辛描笼涯伊辛战役纪念碑前的阿古桑—达沃公路路口起，经新卡米林、阿莱哈尔与马格塞塞描笼涯）更名为Saturnino R. Silva公路的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Carmen-Santo Tomas Road, Stretching from Junction Agusan-Davao Road Fronting the Battle of Ising Monument in Barangay Ising, Traversing Through Barangays New Camiling, Alejal and Magsaysay, All in the Municipality of Carmen, Province of Davao Del Norte, as Saturnino R. Silva Road

title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Đường Carmen-Santo Tomas tại Đô thị Carmen, Tỉnh Davao Del Norte thành Đường Saturnino R. Silva
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อถนน Carmen-Santo Tomas ในเทศบาล Carmen จังหวัด Davao Del Norte เป็น ถนน Saturnino R. Silva
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Jalan Carmen-Santo Tomas di Kotamadya Carmen, Provinsi Davao Del Norte menjadi Jalan Saturnino R. Silva
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Jalan Carmen-Santo Tomas di Perbandaran Carmen, Wilayah Davao Del Norte kepada Jalan Saturnino R. Silva

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11731_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Carmen-Santo Tomas Road, stretching from Junction Agusan-Davao Road fronting the Battle of Ising Monument in Barangay Ising, traversing through barangays New Camiling, Alejal and Magsaysay, all in the Municipality of Carmen, Province of Davao del Norte, is hereby renamed as Saturnino R. Silva Road.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act within sixty (60) days from its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
